name: biashara-yangu-android
description: Android (Capacitor) wrapper for the Biashara Yangu web app

scripts.sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.run:device: npm run sync && cap run android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.aab:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
